description_en: Set to `1` to allow 24-bit truecolor output inside tmux. By default, Claude Code clamps to 256 colors when `$TMUX` is set because tmux does not pass through truecolor escape sequences unless configured to. Set this after adding `set -ga terminal-overrides ',*:Tc'` to your `~/.tmux.conf`. See [Terminal configuration](/en/terminal-config) for other tmux settings
description_ja: 1 を設定すると、tmux 内で 24bit トゥルーカラー出力を許可します。
